name: Big Black Mace
label: Quest
description: Big Black Mace: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: For my act as the strongest woman alive, I plan to accept items from the audience and smash them with a big, black mace!
Can you make me a big black mace, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, perfect! This mace has a big, heavy head on it. I bet I could smash just about anything with it. I just hope I don't break it along with whatever I swing it against!
Here are your tickets, friend. Enjoy your stay at the faire!
